title: Generated plotting coverage classifier
objective: Generate a deterministic coverage.json classifying every pinned Sage and frontend plotting entry as faithful, translated, unsupported, or extension, with evidence completeness checks and no ambiguous partial state.

oracles: Pinned Sage surface and checked-in frontend surface artifacts

handoff.summary: Generated a deterministic 642-entry product ledger from the pinned Sage 10.9.post1 and Wolfram/MATLAB frontend inventories. Every entry has exactly one faithful, translated, unsupported, or extension status; the generator preserves source authority, validates exhaustive joins and evidence paths, and records explicit per-entry semantic, Plotly, visual, platform, and performance debt. Focused regeneration tests pass and strict baselib validation passes.
risks: The initial ledger is deliberately conservative: most exact Sage class and method semantics remain unsupported until focused evidence exists, and translated records explicitly retain parity debt.
The full integration tier fails in this worktree because FLINT headers, generated adapters, production kernels, and sagejs_flint.node are absent; the failures are unrelated to the JSON classifier.
The integration lane must register the three new plotting inventory/classifier tests in the central test manifest, which this lane was instructed not to edit.
next_steps: Integrate both inventory dependencies before this classifier commit and add their three focused tests to the central test manifest.
Re-run the integration tier in a bootstrapped native workspace and replace the recorded failed receipt with a passing one.
Promote unsupported entries only when exact semantic, PlotSpec, Plotly, and visual evidence is added; coverage.json will then make the resulting progress measurable.
